title: leucas flagellifera
intro: Leucas flagellifera, commonly known as 'Biswambada' or 'Wild Jasmine', is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Leucas flagellifera include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, skin diseases, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing irritated skin and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Leucas flagellifera include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
